question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Transmisible"** is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is **"Transmissible," **which means capable of being transmitted from one person or organism to another. (संचरणीय)

 
 
• **Example: **Influenza is a highly **transmissible **disease.
 
 
 
• **"Transmissible"** refers to something that can be passed or spread from one individual to another. (संचरणीय)
 
 
• **Example: **The virus is **transmissible **through direct contact.
 
 

Therefore, the correct spelling is** 'transmissible.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Essence** (सार): The intrinsic nature or indispensable quality of something that determines its character.

 
 
• **Example:** The **essence **of his argument was that education should be accessible to all.
 
 
 
• **Aggregate** (समुच्चय): A whole formed by combining several (typically disparate) elements.
 
 
• **Example: **The** aggregate** score of the two teams was 76.
 
 
 
• **Assembly** (सभा): A group of people gathered together in one place for a common purpose.
 
 
• **Example: **The **assembly** gathered to discuss the new policy changes.
